Title: Madhuparna Thakur Makes History As Youngest MLA At 25 | TimelineDaily
* #### Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool To Support INDIA Candidate K Suresh For Speaker. * #### “Serious Concerns...”: Rahul Gandhi On EVM Access To Winning Candidate's Relative In Maharashtra. * #### EVM Access To Winning Candidate's Relative: "Fraud At Highest Level," Says Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Priyanka Chaturvedi. ## Madhuparna Thakur Makes History As Youngest MLA At 25. ### TMC's Madhuparna Thakur, who won from Bagda seat in West Bengal, has created history by becoming the youngest MLA in the House. Madhuparna Thakur Makes History As Youngest MLA At 25 (image-twitter/TrinankurWBTMCP). Madhuparna Thakur, daughter of Trinamool Congress MP Mamatabala Tagore has been elected as the youngest MLA in the state assembly. She has created history by winning the by-elections from the Matua-dominated Bagda seat at the age of only 25. Madhuparna has been elected from Bagda constituency by winning against BJP’s Binay Kumar Biswas by a margin of 33,455 votes. Read also: **By-Election Result 2024: INDIA Bloc Wins 6, Leading In Five; NDA Leads In Two Seats**. The Dalit Matua community has a sizeable presence at Bagdah and Ranaghat South assembly seats which had gone for polls on July 10th alongside Raiganj and Manicktala in West Bengal. The byelection for this Assembly constituency was necessitated because of resignation of Biswajit Das. There were a total of nine candidates in the fray. The ruling Trinamool Congress won from Bagda Assembly constituency in 2011 and 2016. BJP managed to win the Bagdah assembly seat in 2021. Biswajit Das who contested on a BJP ticket in the 2021 assembly elections from Bagdah after switching over from Trinamool Congress managed to secure a victory. Das again joined the Trinamool Congress ahead of Lok Sabha elections this year and contested the poll from Bongaon Lok Sabha seat on TMC’s ticket but lost to BJP’s Shantanu Thakur. Bagda is an assembly constituency in West Bengal. The Congress had fielded Ashoka Kumar Haldar for Bagdah Assembly bypolls while All India Forward Bloc nominated Gour Biswas as their candidate. Title: "Relationship with sister-in-law not to come in way of polls": TMC's Madhuparna Thakur casts vote as Bagda witnesses clash of family members
Add ANI As A Trusted Source For Reliable Information. TMC candidate Madhuparna Thakur (Photo/ANI). # "Relationship with sister-in-law not to come in way of polls": TMC's Madhuparna Thakur casts vote as Bagda witnesses clash of family members. North 24 Parganas (West Bengal) [India], April 29 (ANI): Madhuparna Thakur, a representative of the Matua Thakur family and the Trinamool candidate for the Bagda constituency, cast her vote at a polling booth in Thakurnagar in North 24 Parganas as the polling for the second phase of the West Bengal elections is underway. Madhuparna Thakur is contesting against her sister-in-law and Union Minister Shantanu Thakur's wife, Soma Thakur. The TMC leader said that her personal relationship did not come in the way of the elections. In Bagda, the people are very simple and educated. My relationship with my sister-in-law (who is contesting against her on the BJP ticket) will not come in the way of this election as I will give my 100 per cent," Madhuparna Thakur told ANI. The Bagda seat has been held by three different parties in the last three elections. In the 2021 polls, the BJP leader Biswajit Das won against TMC's Paritosh Kumar Saha by a margin of 9,792 (4.5 per cent). The seat was won by Congress in 2016 and TMC in 2011. In a contest of two family members, both the BJP and the TMC are banking on the Matua community's vote. West Bengal recorded a voter turnout of 18.39 per cent until 9 am, as polling for the 142 seats in the second phase of the Assembly elections is underway. Bagda constituency recorded a voter turnout of 16.63 per cent at 9 am. The main fight in West Bengal in the 2026 elections is between the Trinamool Congress and the BJP. Earlier in the day, West Bengal LoP Suvendu Adhikari inspected the polling booths in Bhabanipur constituency.
